structure_explanation.en: The sentence opens with the interrogative expression どれくらい (どれ, the target, + くらい = 'how much, roughly?'), which here asks 'how long'. The verb かかる ('to take/cost time') is the core. At the end, の (a nominalizer that gives an indirect-question tone) + かしら (a final particle expressing 'I wonder...?', with a soft/feminine nuance) turn it all into a self-directed musing: 'I wonder how long it will take?'.
